agenda, except that members of the City Council or staff may briefly respond

rights (Government Code Section 54954.2).

CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  May 22, 2023-4:30 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber

OPENING:  Mayor Gordo called the regular meeting to order at 5:35 p.m. The
  pledge of allegiance was led by Councilmember Rivas. (Absent:
  Councilmember Madison)

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Victor M. Gordo
  Councilmembers:  Vice Mayor Felicia Williams
  Councilmember Tyron Hampton
  Councilmember Justin Jones
  I

  City Clerk Mark Jomsky

CEREMONIAL MATTERS Chief Harris introduced and welcomed the new Sergeant-At-Arms,
  Sergeant Mac Adesina, and extended appreciation to Sergeant Jack
  Rappuchi for his service.

  Mayor Gordo presented a proclamation to Tony Olmos, Director of
  Public Works, declaring May 21, 2023 through May 27, 2023 as
  "National Public Works Week" in Pasadena. Mr. Olmos thanked the
  Mayor and City Council on behalf of the Public Works staff for this
  recognition.

  Mayor Gordo presented a proclamation to Lola Osborne, Acting
Councilmember Madison  Director of Parks, Recreation, & Community Services (PRCS), and
arrived at 5:48 p.m.  Daniel Fong, Day One, declaring June 2, 2023 as "Gun Violence
  Awareness Day" in the City of Pasadena. Mr. Fong thanked the
  Mayor and City Council on behalf of Day One for focusing on this
  important issue, and invited the City Council and community to the
  "Orange you Ready for Gun Control" event that will occur on Friday,
  June 4, 2023.

  Mayor Gordo introduced Lola Osborne, PRCS Acting Director, and
  Michael Pierce, Acting Deputy Director of Libraries, who spoke on
  Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) Heritage Month, and
  provided a brochure to the City Council on the various events and
  programs occurring this month in recognition of the important
  contributions of the AAPI community in Pasadena.
